description: This file defines the 'Contacts' class within the 'Step\Acceptance' namespace. The class provides functionality to automate the creation of a contact in the SuiteCRM testing framework, utilizing page object classes for interacting with the UI, and Faker for generating realistic test data.

classes.name: Contacts
classes.description: A test step class for creating contacts within SuiteCRM acceptance tests, encapsulating interactions with the contact creation UI.
